faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JERC-JKL Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 January 2027.

faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Independent Member, CGRF (JPDCL), 1 Independent Member, CGRF (KPDCL), 1 Independent Member, CGRF (LPDD).

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II of this notice; also on http://jercjkl.jk.gov.in) and send it to Secretary, Joint Electricity Regulatory Commission for UTs of J&K and Ladakh, Railway Road, Ambedkar Chowk Jammu (J&K) 180016, by registered post, to reach by 15 January 2027.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30,000 (monthly consolidated) for Independent Member, CGRF (JPDCL), Rs. 30,000 (monthly consolidated) for Independent Member, CGRF (KPDCL), Rs. 30,000 (monthly consolidated) for Independent Member, CGRF (LPDD).

faq.answer: Bachelor's degree preferably in Engineering (Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics/Computer)/Law/Public Administration/Journalism/Economics/Political Science or equivalent; 5 years of experience in power sector related matters; retired civil servant of Additional Secretary level of UT of J&K/Deputy Secretary level in Govt. of India (Level 12) OR retired Electrical Engineer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer with experience in distribution of electricity.
